nodes.description: *Advent of Artemis* inflicts 1 additional stack of :effect{param="lethal-injury"}.
nodes.activeDesc:
When entering battle, gain *[Way of Artemis]*; if there is already *[Way of Ares]* or *[Way of Nyx]* on self, gain Critical Rate **+15%** instead.

*[Way of Artemis]*: *[Force Field]* effect: All allies gain DMG Bonus +(**27%** + number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**5.4%**). :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional DMG Bonus +(number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**5.4%**).

nodes.description:
When *Fury of Ares*, *Advent of Artemis*, or :effect{param="rain-of-destruction-id-0"} hits the targets, inflict 1 additional stack of :effect{param="lethal-injury"} on them.

Current *[Force Field]* New Effect Added: When an allied :effect{param="assassination"} is triggered, deal an additional **50%** DMG of the attacker's type.

:effect{param="sparta-kick-id-0"}, :effect{param="rain-of-destruction-id-2"}, and :effect{param="rush-assassination-id-0"} trigger 1 additional stack of :effect{param="lethal-injury"}.

Current *[Force Field]* New Effect Added: When an allied :effect{param="assassination"} is triggered, deal an additional **75%** DMG of the attacker's type.
nodes.activeDesc: *[Way of Artemis]* effect improved. All allies gain Critical Rate **+15%**. :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional Critical Rate **+10%**.

When entering battle, gain *[Way of Ares]*; if there is already *[Way of Artemis]* or *[Way of Nyx]* on self, gain Incantation Might **+18%** instead.

*[Way of Ares]*: *[Force Field]* effect: All allies gain DMG Bonus +(**14%** + number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**2.8%**). :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional DMG Bonus +(number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**2.8%**).

nodes.description:
:effect{param="sparta-kick-id-0"} inflicts :effect{param="kick-gash-id-0"} on the target hit for 3 rounds.
:effect{param="rain-of-destruction-id-0"} inflicts :effect{param="arrow-gash-id-0"} on the targets hit for 3 rounds.
:effect{param="rush-assassination-id-0"} inflicts :effect{param="assassination-gash-id-0"} on the target hit for 3 rounds.
:effect{param="rush-assassination-combo-id-0"} inflicts :effect{param="assassination-gash-id-0"} on the target hit for 3 rounds.
*Fury of Ares*: For every different type of :effect{param="gash-id-0"} on the main target, cast :effect{param="sparta-kick-id-1"} to them again.
nodes.activeDesc: *[Way of Ares]* effect improved. All allies gain Incantation Might **+18%**. :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional Incantation Might **+12%**.

nodes.description: When Kassandra performs an :effect{param="assassination"}, for every 100 points of Critical Technique the attacker has more than the target, the attack gains an additional Final DMG Dealt **+1%**.
nodes.activeDesc:
When entering battle, gain *[Way of Nyx]*; if there is already *[Way of Artemis]* or *[Way of Ares]* on self, gain Penetration Rate **+24%** instead.

*[Way of Nyx]*: *[Force Field]* effect: All allies gain ATK +(**7%** + number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**1.4%**). :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional ATK +(number of :effect{param="guidance-of-three-gods"} stacks x**1.4%**).

nodes.description:
Grants :effect{param="assassination"} instead of *Fury of Ares*, *Advent of Artemis*.

*Falconer's Instinct* no longer grants :effect{param="sparta-kick-id-0"} or :effect{param="rain-of-destruction-id-0"}.

:effect{param="rush-assassination-id-0"} New Effect Added: After scoring a critical hit, gain :effect{param="preparation-kassandra-id-0"}.

When an allied :effect{param="assassination"} is triggered or when an allied Ultimate is cast, gain Adrenaline +1.
nodes.activeDesc: *[Way of Nyx]* effect improved. All allies gain Penetration Rate **+24%**. :effect{param="assassination"} allies gain an additional Penetration Rate **+16%**.
